# 2 Baruch Chapter 42 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**42:1** And he answered and said to me: These things also I will explain to you.

**42:2** As for those who were neither righteous nor wicked, but lived in the middle — these are they who were troubled in their lifetime and suffered tribulation, though they did not serve the wicked and did not walk in the paths of the just; and they will be destroyed.

**42:3** But those who have walked in this world without righteousness and with love of falsehood, and have not remembered the law of the Mighty One — those will be taken in the judgment, and they will have no remembrance at that time.

**42:4** But as for those who have truly loved the law and have not lived a double life with regard to their wisdom — these are they who will inherit the world that will not pass away.

**42:5** And those who will be separated by the law from among the mixed ones — those will be counted among the righteous.

**42:6** For the law will be the judge at that time; it will divide the just from the unjust, and place the righteous on the right and the wicked on the left.

**42:7** This therefore is the answer I have given to your question.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "lived in the middle" (v.2) over PNEUMA's "somewhere in between" — more formal; "double life" (v.4) retained — the Syriac concept of living duplicitously with respect to one's wisdom/faith; "the law will be the judge" (v.6) preserved as the chapter's theological climax; right/left division preserved (v.6).*
